root_causes.issue: Fourteen allowed tabs but limit 12 on admin save, silently loses PDFs/Marketplace
root_causes.fix: Both governed list maxima raised from 12 to 14, testing persisted roundtrip.

root_causes.issue: Invalid public tab or optional provider list fell back to expansive full default, bypassing prior opt-outs
root_causes.fix: Fallback to overview-only or no optional providers on malformed explicit input.

root_causes.issue: Malformed explicit privacy-sensitive booleans re-enabled public visibility/metrics/local search via true schema default
root_causes.fix: Fail-closed malformed settings; preserve explicit true/false and fresh-install defaults.

root_causes.issue: 120-byte checks prematurely excluded valid 120-character Urdu/Unicode REST search, REST topic and HTML topic
root_causes.fix: 120 Unicode codepoints with bounded 480 raw UTF8 bytes in both REST and HTML; mbstring-independent codepoint fallback.

root_causes.issue: REST topic allowed hidden bidi/format controls excluded by profile-local search
root_causes.fix: Use the same normalized strict Unicode and format-control policy for topic and search.

false_alarm.reason: Preexisting Plan_Completion::normalize_search_query already rejects bidi override/format controls; not counted as a defect.
